scope.excluded_execution: Dropbox-mounted raw data intake, full 390 numerical batch, and Dropbox output upload. These require the local/cloud environment holding the user's Dropbox mount and must be separately receipted.
scope.goal: Fortran numerical backend + Python thin frontend; preserve the historical 390-key EOS matrix and separately validate sharp-Maxwell Cowling physics.

pins.supersedes: No historical raw/source/output artifact; this is the top-level cloud execution DAG.

authority.rule: This graph controls task sequencing/status. The subsystem EOS DAG remains authoritative for detailed physics/source constraints where not superseded.

css.classification_rule: Sharp first order only if supplied Delta_epsilon>0 and P/mu/first-law jump conditions pass.

method_ontology.general_rule: Numerical interpolation method is not physical transition classification; preserve phase boundaries and never interpolate across a true discontinuity.

legacy_first_law_bridge.actual_description: Project-defined first-law-constrained Hermite pressure bridge (historical NPPHB parameterization); continuous density, no latent-heat jump and no Maxwell coexistence.

conditions: local electric charge neutrality in each phase

method_ontology.historical_v1_artifact_policy: Existing v1 output directories/task IDs containing __maxwell identify the old NPPHB parameterization and remain byte-for-byte immutable. Active code and new manifests use FLCHPB; the method ID maxwell means sharp first-order coexistence only.

data_contract.Nadd_q_extra: provider-defined typed extension; categorical fields must never be averaged/interpolated
data_contract.SPG_GPPVA_semantics: BLOCKED until provider-authored definition for Iphase=0/7, Abar/Zbar, group fraction and neutron-gas representation
data_contract.multidimensional_policy: preserve all exact indices and axes; no flattening/averaging/nearest-grid guessing/field drops

mutation_gates.name: Live source lock
mutation_gates.rule: Fetch exact heads/tree/status before any mutation; stop on drift.

mutation_gates.name: Branch isolation
mutation_gates.rule: Use child branches/worktrees; never delete dirty work, reset, force push or auto-merge.

mutation_gates.name: Source provenance
mutation_gates.rule: Hash original EOS, CompOSE sheets, papers, optional files and historical outputs; raw and old outputs are read-only.

mutation_gates.name: TDD
mutation_gates.rule: Failing test first, observe intended failure, then smallest production fix; run complete suite.

mutation_gates.name: Physical semantics
mutation_gates.rule: Do not map ambiguous provider fields or infer phase order from method/Iphase labels.

mutation_gates.name: Numerics
mutation_gates.rule: Fortran unit/analytic tests, independent formulas, edge cases and convergence; failures retained.

mutation_gates.name: Native-only
mutation_gates.rule: No Python numerical fallback in production; PASS requires native executable identity/evidence.

mutation_gates.name: Batch cardinality
mutation_gates.rule: Exactly 390 historical task keys, no duplicates/omissions, unique versioned output root.

mutation_gates.name: Read-back
mutation_gates.rule: Each PASS output is read by native Fortran and independently validated.

mutation_gates.name: Immutability
mutation_gates.rule: Compare old outputs to trusted baseline hashes, never 'unchanged by construction'.

mutation_gates.name: Cloud/local boundary
mutation_gates.rule: Cloud CI and Dropbox-mount run are separate receipts and may not substitute for one another.

mutation_gates.name: Publication
mutation_gates.rule: No unapproved merge/release or unacknowledged Dropbox upload.

anti_drift_questions: What exact repository, branch, HEAD, tree, PR base/head and clean-state were observed?
Which complete source files and input data were inspected and hashed?
Does each method token preserve its historical physical meaning?
Is a smooth interpolant being mislabelled a phase transition?
Are left/right interface values explicit and all stencils phase-local?
Are absent, explicit-zero and model-generated-zero fields distinguished?
Are C3 and C4 independently applicable and validated row by row?
Are Iphase and Nadd/q_extra categorical and provider-defined?
Did any Python numerical routine enter a production path?
Does every PASS prove native Fortran generation, complete combined output and read-back?
Are all 390 exact task keys present exactly once?
Are old outputs compared against trusted baseline hashes?
Are equations, units, metric signature, state orientation and approximation regime explicit?
Are slow/rapid physical endpoints separate from LA10 algebraic interpolation?
Was actual native RHS and q-to-r chain rule derived from source?
Are basis/gauge/scale determinant phases retained for complex matching?
Are mode labels based on node/profile/overlap/continuation evidence?
Do logs, manifests, stdout, test collection and report agree on counts?
Were all failures/negative controls preserved?
Were no unapproved raw-data, output-folder, Dropbox or remote branch mutations performed?
